Params: {3: 'A heavy dimness fills the belly of the crab, punctuated by brief, crackling sparks that draw fleeting white lines across the void.'}
{3: 'Karenina moves forward, her flashlight carving a corridor of white through the black, while you stay close and read the space around you.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "This place used to be a straight shot to the core. Now it's a maze.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'The Punishing Virus has already eaten through this colossal machine, and Arius has reshaped what remained. The interior is now unrecognizable. Chambers are crushed and contorted, and any semblance of passageways is long gone.'}
{2: "This section hasn't changed much, at least.", 3: '24'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Cordelia's map is still holding. We find the core control room, input the key, and trigger the self-destruct. Simple.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Suddenly, Karenina's finger lands on a specific point on the map and stays there."}
{3: 'That noise she knows all too well rises from the depths of her M.I.N.D., drifting upward like bubbles toward the surface of still water.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "According to the map, the crab's core should be...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Hah... Someone had opinions about interior decorating.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She tosses off light complaints as she picks her way through passageways that grow more and more alien to the map, acting as though the ceaseless noise has never reached her ears.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'If Arius wants full control of this node, the crab is the key. Everything runs through it.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'So the fastest way to wreck his plans is... to trigger the self-destruct from inside the crab itself.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'That should take a great deal of pressure off the northern node.'}
{2: 'I hope Lucia and Lee are managing.', 3: '53'}
{1: 'Far away at the northern node, Lucia and Lee are surely locked in their own fierce struggle.', 5: '3'}
{1: 'But you know they will hold. Countless battles fought shoulder to shoulder, blood shed together, hearts laid bare, all of it has bound your souls too tightly to ever come apart.'}
{1: 'Though separated by vast distances, on different battlefields, every one of you fights for the same cause.', 7: '1'}

{3: 'The Arctic Route Union reinforcements have formed a defensive ring around the node, their cannons aimed outward. Without pause, they pour fire across the sea, holding back the tide of Hetero-Creatures surging toward them.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'ARU Reinforcement Squad Member', 3: "Twenty minutes... it's only been twenty minutes, and the line is already...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The enemies surge forward without end, threatening to break through the faltering defenses at any second.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'ARU Reinforcement Squad Member', 3: "Seven o'clock! Watch it!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "A blade scrapes across the Corrupted's metal shell, the shriek of steel on steel echoing with the pounding heart."}
{3: 'Then the fierce weapon sweeps in again from the side, cutting down the enemy with effortless precision and shoring up the line just before it collapses.'}
{3: "The katana leaves its sheath and bites deep into the roiling, rotted flesh of the whale's belly. The instant the blade sinks home, a jet of black, foul liquid erupts skyward."}
{3: 'Lightning splits the heavens as the giant creature heaves its final groan, and when its massive body crashes down, a ten-meter wave explodes outward.'}
{3: 'Lucia rides the surge of the wave and spins back onto the node platform in a single motion. Below, more dark red shapes begin to surface from the deep.'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "We're too few to hold a wide front forever. I can keep fighting, but the gaps will come.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'We close the circle and hold what matters most.', 4: '2'}
{3: "Lucia's even tone spreads a quiet calm through those around her. The squad members tighten their hold on their weapons."}
{3: 'Lucia nods and looks back toward the control center.'}
{3: "Unlike the chaos raging outside, the node's interior is eerily still, the only sound the low hiss of electricity threading through the silence."}
{3: 'There are no endless swarms of enemies here, no desperate melee. Only one person, facing a battlefield just as turbulent as the one outside.'}
{3: 'A vast panel unfolds before Lee, and as his fingers fly across it, his mind, his processing speed, and his entire body become weapons in their own right.'}
{3: "Ever since the Jormungandr node fell into Arius' hands, the temporary protocol that once ran smoothly has been hanging by a thread."}
{3: 'In a sea invisible to the naked eye, the Sefirah pulls at the data tides like a distant moon, and what now surges toward Lee is a torrent more frenzied and unstoppable than anything before.'}
{3: "Now, only Lee alone stands between the surging flood and humanity's faltering information network."}
{3: "He pushes back against the Sefirah's raging tide, fighting to hold the framework of this vast system together."}
{1: 'The reality is far grimmer than his calm words suggest.', 5: '3'}
{1: 'Turning himself into a pure "instrument," Lee rips through pattern recognition and data sorting at a terrifying speed.'}
{1: 'Each wave of chaotic attack data is tagged, classified, and forcibly intercepted.'}
{1: 'Even if he cannot process it all, he slows the flood enough to keep the system from drowning.', 7: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: 'If I had more conversion repeaters to work with...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Lee has no room left for thought. It is not the first time he has been swallowed by chaos this immense, burning through himself to carve out a path.'}
{3: 'The formless enormity wraps around him now, shoving hard, no longer hiding its horror. It throws everything at him, determined to crush him and consume him whole.'}

{3: 'The data on the panel churns and heaves like a storm-torn ocean about to devour the sky and earth alike. Bright red warnings drown the display, the gaping jaws of some monstrous predator lunging straight for him.'}
{3: 'The faintest thread of blue, safety nearly crushed beneath the overwhelming red, flickers wildly and then begins to reclaim the screen, patch by stubborn patch.'}
{3: 'A ghost of a smile touches his lips.'}
{3: 'Then a still greater wave comes crashing in, and Lee steadies his mind and dives into the next battle.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: '(If... I had more conversion repeaters to work with...)', 4: '18'}
{3: 'If he had more conversion repeaters to work with, it would ease the pressure considerably. But no more reinforcements are coming across the water.'}
{3: 'The clouds around the island droop so low they nearly graze the sea, and the waves slam in like collapsing mountains.'}
{3: 'Their crests gnash like the fangs of wild beasts, tearing into one another and exploding into a sky full of salt mist.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Aaaaah! Get us out of here, Larsen! Faster!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Larsen swipes the seawater from his face. Their tiny boat pitches between the swells like a single drifting leaf.'}
{3: 'Wind screams through the bow, and the planks moan without pause.'}
{3: 'Far off, wave after wave of water mountains crumble and rise again, as if they will never stop.'}
{3: 'Where else is there to run? Who else is there to pray to?'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "You can't seriously be thinking of leaving the captain behind!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: 'She told us to go, so we just run? She never left us behind. How can we do that to her?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'As captain of both the team and the vessel, Karenina always throws herself to the front, bearing the weight of everything for everyone.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'I... but what can we even do now...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: "The replacement protocol needs conversion repeaters. As many as we can feed it... That's what we can do!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: 'If that guy wins, what good is running? Comms go dark, the surface defense lines shatter, and where do we go then?', 4: '2'}
{3: 'The gale and the sea strike his face, and with his eyes clenched tight, he hurls his voice into the storm.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "We're the cable crew from the Engineering Force. Deployed to the Atlantic for emergency repeater restoration. Our leader, our captain, is Karenina.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: 'We still have a mission to finish.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Towering waves swallow the sky. The tiny boat pitches in the chaos, surrounded by a haze of salt spray. An impossible mission. Efforts that seem doomed to fail. And yet, here they are, as small and fragile humans.'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: "Do what we're supposed to do. That's enough.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'The storm has rendered the deep-sea equipment useless. The two cable-laying crew members have no choice but to replace the repeaters by hand.', 5: '3'}
{1: 'Their frames can barely reach the depth where the repeaters sit, and the few they manage to swap are a drop in the ocean.'}
{1: 'The gathering Red Tide eats into their frames with every descent. The next dive could swallow them whole, their frames lost forever in the crimson sea.', 7: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: '(But we have to thrash on... No. We have to hold on.)', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: 'Sidkosanatrahk. Just hold on... one moment longer than the last.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'His comrade laughs, then yells into the wind.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Old man! We need a little more time!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Larsen does not look back. The sea wind tears at his clothes, and he grips the helm until his knuckles go white.'}
{3: "It's the same as always. Those young, spirited voices, reckless and unafraid, have never changed."}
{3: 'These waters never run short of these bright, burning souls.'}
{3: 'Just like that rain-soaked night years ago that ruined everything, the shadow of fate now hangs over the flame of souls that burns too fiercely.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Old man, keep her steady! I'm going in!", 4: '2'}
{3: "The storm stuffs his ears full. He can't even hear the young Construct break the water."}
{3: 'Fate broke him that night. So what about tonight?'}

{3: 'Behind him stand new comrades, and ahead, a storm no different from the one that came before. He must hold the line. Hold it to the very end, and drag these two death-bound young souls with him.'}
{3: 'Marine engineer Larsen grips the helm as the wind and waves drag him backward through the years.'}
